en.html:
...For me, Muramasa only. At most, that was the match I could claim.

Cold steel.
Iron of blood's color.
The shape of an insect crawling on the ground.
No warmth, no softness. A blade only.

For someone like me—that was the proper place.

ja.html:
……俺に似合うのはせいぜい村正だろう。

　冷たい鋼。
　血の色の鉄。
　地べたを這い回る虫の形。
　温もりも柔らかさもない、ただの刃。

　それが――俺には分相応だ。
